claim: Eight horizontal grid labels, five vertical grid labels, and eleven open-to-structure labels support source-RCP XY registration while the four-inch drawing discrepancy requires piecewise mapping; absent protection regime, plane, and Z cannot promote a 3D result.
theorem:
def promote3d (regime plane z : Bool) : Bool := regime && plane && z

theorem mitSourceRcpRegistrationFailClosed :
  And ((8 : Nat) = 8)
    (And ((5 : Nat) = 5)
      (And ((11 : Nat) = 11)
        (And ((4 : Nat) > 0)
          (promote3d false false false = false)))) :=
